scphasedcn

Single-cell copy-number calling for SPLONGGET: single-cell long-read DNA sequencing in which every read carries a 10x Multiome cell barcode and is sequenced on Oxford Nanopore. scphasedcn combines read depth with read-phased alleles (each molecule covering a phased heterozygous SNP votes for a haplotype), per cell and region:

  • normal tissue: rare, cell-private gains, losses and copy-neutral LOH, with thresholds calibrated on null cells (1 false call per 1,000 null cell-regions), per cell and in cell pools;
  • tumours: clone discovery, allele-specific clone copy-number profiles, likelihood assignment of every cell, per-cell inherited / confirmed calls, and input for MEDICC2 trees.

The repository holds two packages, both named scphasedcn, that are used together:

package language does
scphasedcn (Python, python/) Python (pysam) BAM -> extraction directory: per-cell 100 kb bin counts, a fragment table with haplotypes, cell QC
scphasedcn (R, root) R extraction directory -> calls, clones, tables

Install

Container (Docker / Apptainer / Singularity; R, Python, both packages and htslib):

apptainer pull docker://ghcr.io/ljwharbers/scphasedcn:0.1.1
apptainer exec scphasedcn_0.1.1.sif scphasedcn --help

Conda (from a checkout):

git clone https://github.com/ljwharbers/scphasedcn && cd scphasedcn
conda env create -f environment.yml && conda activate scphasedcn      # or micromamba
pip install ./python && R CMD INSTALL .
bash tools/smoke_test.sh                                            # end-to-end check on simulated data

To reproduce results exactly, use the container of the release: per-cell calls are identical across installations, but the chromatin-kNN pooled calls depend slightly on the BLAS and irlba versions.

From source into existing installations: pip install ./python (Python >= 3.10) and, in R (>= 4.2), install.packages("pak"); pak::pak("ljwharbers/scphasedcn") (Bioconductor dependencies: rhdf5, Rsamtools). A tabix on the PATH speeds up reading the fragment table.

Quick start 

# 1. phased heterozygous SNPs (Clair3 + longphase on the pooled BAM; see vignette("scphasedcn-inputs"))
scphasedcn select-hets --vcf sample.longphase.vcf.gz --loci 1000G_snvs_hg38.vcf.gz --out het_phased.vcf.gz

# 2. extraction (all chromosomes in parallel, then merge)
scphasedcn run --bam sample.bam --barcodes barcodes.tsv.gz --fasta GRCh38.fa \
    --snps het_phased.vcf.gz --phased --out results/sample/extract --jobs 8

# 3. calling
CALL=$(Rscript -e 'cat(system.file("scripts", "call_scn.R", package = "scphasedcn"))')   # in the container: call_scn.R
Rscript $CALL --dir results/sample/extract --out results/sample/caller --sex female --mode normal --null-cells select

or in R:

library(scphasedcn)
res = call_scn("results/sample/extract", mode = "tumour", sex = "male")
write_scphasedcn(res, "results/sample/caller")

Documentation: https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/, or in R vignette("scphasedcn") (overview and a run on simulated data), vignette("scphasedcn-inputs") (input requirements, phasing recipe, extraction, cell metadata), vignette("scphasedcn-outputs") (result tables).

Scope: GRCh38 / hg38 with chr names; Linux and macOS.
